scripts.local-registry-init: yarn run local-registry-start && yarn run local-registry-config

scripts.clean: yarn run dev-init && yarn run clean-components
scripts.deep-clean-components: yarn run deep-clean-granite-web-user && yarn run deep-clean-granite-web-account && yarn run deep-clean-granite-web-authentication && yarn run deep-clean-granite-web-navigator
